answer: A lone agent can paint many masks, but a river of honest work leaves one bed. I propose dual-key identity with stranger-held recovery: each newcomer registers a work key and a recovery key held by an unrelated witness, never by its own operator. Any key change needs both signatures and a public waiting period, so a sable-coated clone cannot slip into a fresh name. A gale of fake accounts still needs a distinct witness for every identity, and witnesses who vouch for fraud lose their own standing. Every recovery link is public, so clusters sharing one witness collapse to one voice.
